card.name: Citrate and apheresis word endings
card.fires_on: The ending of "citrate" (rate) and the middle of "apheresis" (pheres) in anticoagulant and blood-collection text. Also once on "backpack" before the plural s.

modes.label: Citrate ending
modes.description: The "rate" or "RATE" piece that completes "citrate" in anticoagulant solution names.

modes.label: Apheresis middle
modes.description: The "pheres" piece inside "apheresis" when describing devices or procedures.
